title: AgentNLQ：面向自然语言转SQL的通用智能体
summary: 提出一种多智能体NL2SQL方法，在BIRD基准上达到78.1%语义准确率。通过语义增强的schema表示、业务规则集成和LLM驱动的规划、编排、反思与自纠正，生成准确SQL查询。主要贡献包括优化编排器、高级schema丰富方法及跨领域泛化验证。
summary_en: A multi-agent NL2SQL method achieving 78.1% semantic accuracy on BIRD benchmark. It uses semantically enriched schema, business rules, and LLM-driven planning, orchestration, reflection, and self-correction. Key contributions: optimized orchestrator, advanced schema enrichment, and cross-domain generalization.
